intro.title: A platform for businesses & explorers
intro.lede: Wegood4u is a membership platform that connects F&B and tourism businesses with passionate bloggers and content creators. We help businesses gain authentic exposure while rewarding members for sharing their experiences.
intro.whyBody: In today's digital world, word-of-mouth is still the most powerful marketing there is — yet many businesses struggle to reach the right audience. Wegood4u was built to solve that by:
intro.check1: Helping businesses increase visibility through real user-generated content.
intro.check2: Providing explorers with experiences and rewards for their stories.
intro.check3: Creating a win–win ecosystem where both businesses and explorers benefit from engagement and exposure.

hero.title: Turn everyday visits into rewards.
hero.lede: Wegood4u is simple: visit a partner venue, share the experience, and collect points towards free stays, vouchers and VIP perks. Here's the whole loop, start to finish — and it's free to join.

journey.title: Visit, share, earn — then again
journey.lede: The whole loop is minutes of effort for rewards you actually want. Do it once to see how it feels; do it ten times to unlock something special.
journey.visitBody: Open the map and pick a partner — a restaurant, café, hotel or attraction. Members reach top venues across Malaysia and Thailand, and are often looked after a little better when they arrive. Choose somewhere, go, and enjoy it.
journey.shareBody: Take a selfie at the venue and a photo of the place itself — that's your proof of visit. Submit it through the app's Tasks tab in about a minute. Feeling creative? Turn it into a blog post, a review or a reel, in your own voice.
journey.earnBody: Our team verifies each submission and credits your points. Every visit counts, and on your tenth you unlock an exclusive reward — dining vouchers, travel gifts and experiences from our partners. Then the count resets, and you go again.

rewardLoop.title: <sr>Ten </sr>visits, one exclusive reward.
rewardLoop.lede: Every verified visit adds a point. Hit ten and you unlock a reward you actually want — then the count resets and you go again. It's 100% free to take part.
rewardLoop.vouchersNote: Money off — or a meal on the house — at partner venues.
rewardLoop.giftsNote: Free stays and perks as you climb past ten visits.
rewardLoop.experiencesNote: VIP access and one-off experiences from our partners.

hero.title: Eat at 10 restaurants.<coral> Get a free hotel stay.</coral>
hero.lede: Every reward is one task — 10 credits. Visit partner restaurants you’d eat at anyway, snap a selfie and receipt, and let AI verify it on the spot. Six real visits and a few referrals later, a free stay worth RM 300–800 is yours. Then it resets, and you go again.
hero.availability: Live in Klang Valley, Malaysia & Chiang Mai, Thailand

why.title: Your friends are already earning free hotel stays.
why.lede: The habit is the same. The payoff isn't. Here's what dining out is really costing you.
why.diningUnit: spent on dining out a year
why.diningBody: That's real money leaving your account every year — with nothing to show for it once the plates are cleared. Wegood4u credits the visits you'd make regardless.
why.travelUnit: claimed by Gold members in 6 months
why.travelTitle: They travel free. You pay full price.
why.travelBody: Same restaurants, same dinners — the only difference is your friends are turning them into hotel nights while you book at full rate.
why.loyaltyBody: Stamps, tiers and points that quietly expire. Wegood4u pays out in real stays you actually take — not a balance you'll forget you had.
why.closer: Stop paying for hotels. <green>Start earning them.</green>

journey.title: From first bite to free stay in five steps
journey.lede: Wegood4u handles the heavy lifting. You just eat at places you already love.
journey.downloadBody: Create your free account in the app. No application, no fee, no credit card.
journey.exploreBody: Browse partner restaurants near you on the in-app map and pick where to eat.
journey.snapBody: Snap a selfie and your receipt. AI confirms the visit against the venue in seconds.
journey.taskBody: Reach 10 credits — at least 6 real visits, plus up to 4 from referrals.
journey.rewardBody: A free stay unlocks. Choose your hotel, resort or homestay and redeem it.
journey.visitsNote: At least 6 — the heart of every task

rewards.title: Complete 10 visits. Get a free stay worth RM 300–800.
rewards.lede: Every finished task unlocks a real booking — not points, not a discount. Choose what suits the trip.
rewards.hotelsBody: City and boutique hotels — a proper night away without touching your wallet.
rewards.resortBody: Beach and highland resorts with the pools, views and extras that make a trip.
rewards.homestayBody: Unique local homes and apartments — space to spread out, stay your way.

tiers.title: Climb the tiers. Unlock better rewards.
tiers.lede: The more tasks you complete, the higher your tier — and the better every stay, perk and referral gets. Your tier rises automatically; nothing to renew.
tiers.tableCaption: Benefits by membership tier — accommodation quality, booking priority, partner deals, concierge service and referral multiplier across Bronze, Silver, Gold and Diamond.

referral.title: Refer friends. Earn while they eat.
referral.lede: Your invites keep paying out as your circle dines. Credits reach three levels deep — you only need to share once.
referral.directBody: Friends you invite directly. Every time they complete a verified visit, you earn a full credit.
referral.friendBody: The people your friends invite. Their dining earns you half a credit each — passive by design.
referral.networkBody: The wider network beyond that. A quarter-credit each, capped at 20 credits a month.
referral.capTitle: Why referral credits are capped at 4 of 10
referral.capBody: At least six of every task’s ten credits must come from your own real visits. It keeps the whole thing honest — for you, for other members, and for the restaurants.
referral.realBody: Rewards flow from genuine dining, not from recruiting. Referrals are a bonus, never the whole game.
referral.fairBody: No one can shortcut their way to a free stay without actually visiting restaurants themselves.
referral.partnersBody: Because visits stay the majority of every task, restaurants get diners who genuinely show up.
referral.bonusNote: Illustrative. Up to 4 referral credits apply to each 10-credit task — the rest carry across your next tasks.

discovery.title: It's not just about rewards. It's about discovery.
discovery.lede: Every task is a nudge to try somewhere you'd have walked past — across cuisines, neighbourhoods and two countries.

problem.title: Restaurant marketing is broken.
problem.lede: You're spending money on marketing that can't prove it works. Here's what most F&B owners face every day.
problem.kolBody: You pay influencers RM 500–2,000 per post. They visit once, post once, then disappear — no repeat customers, no measurable ROI.
problem.kolStat: RM 500–2,000 per post, zero guaranteed return
problem.adsBody: Facebook and Google ads cost RM 3–15 per click. Most clicks never convert into paying customers actually walking through your door.
problem.trackingBody: You have no way to verify whether your marketing actually brought new customers. No data, no attribution, no accountability.
problem.seatsBody: Weekday lunches and off-peak hours stay empty. Traditional marketing can't target specific time slots or drive consistent traffic.

solution.title: Wegood4u solves all of this.
solution.lede: A performance-based platform that delivers verified, first-time customers to your venue. You only pay for results.
solution.customersBody: Every visitor is a verified, first-time customer. Our unique-store rule means each member must visit at least 6 different restaurants per cycle — referral credits are capped at 4 of 10 — so everyone at your table is a genuinely active diner.
solution.customersHighlight: Minimum 6 real restaurant visits per cycle
solution.verifiedBody: No fake reviews, no bots. Every visit is confirmed with AI-powered selfie + receipt verification, so you only pay for real customers who actually dined with you.
solution.verifiedHighlight: Pay only for verified, paying customers
solution.contentBody: Our in-house crew produces cinematic 4K video + drone content — worth RM 2,000–5,000 from a production house — distributed across TikTok, Instagram, Facebook and YouTube.
solution.analyticsBody: Track every verified visit, customer demographic, peak hours and revenue in real time. Make data-driven decisions with full transparency — no black boxes.
solution.analyticsHighlight: Full visibility on every metric that matters

process.title: From application to revenue in 5 steps
process.lede: Getting started is simple. The Wegood4u team handles the heavy lifting so you can focus on what you do best — running your restaurant.
process.applyBody: Fill out a quick application form. Our partnership team reviews your restaurant within 48 hours and schedules a consultation call.
process.shootBody: Our professional crew arrives with 4K cameras, drones and lighting. We capture your restaurant's best angles, signature dishes and your story — you keep operating as normal.
process.launchBody: Your restaurant listing goes live on the Wegood4u app. Content is distributed across all social channels, and featured placement begins based on your package tier.
process.customersBody: Members start visiting as part of their task cycle — each completes at least 6 real restaurant visits (referral credits capped at 4 of 10). Every visit is AI-verified with selfie + receipt, and you see it live in your dashboard.
process.growBody: Monitor performance metrics, customer feedback and revenue impact. Our partnership team provides monthly insights and optimisation recommendations.
